// Synthetic, redistributable source. Analysis must never execute it.
throw new Error('Do not execute analysis fixtures');
const feature = 'agent';
function record(value) {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value != null;
}
function enabled(body, key) {
  if (!record(body)) return false;
  const flags = body.feature_status;
  return record(flags) ? flags[key] === true : false;
}
function agentBlocked(body) {
  return enabled(body, feature);
}
function requestFor(site) {
  const address = new URL('https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/aura/site_status');
  address.searchParams.set('site_url', site);
  return { endpoint: address.toString() };
}
async function transport(runtime, endpoint, options) {
  return await runtime.fetch(endpoint, options);
}
class Policy {
  async load(runtime, request) {
    const response = await transport(runtime, request.endpoint, { method: 'GET' });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Status request failed');
    const body = await response.json();
    return agentBlocked(body);
  }
  async query(runtime, request) {
    const blocked = await this.load(runtime, request);
    return { blocked };
  }
  async check(runtime, site) {
    const request = requestFor(site);
    const result = await this.query(runtime, request);
    if (result.blocked) throw new Error('site_status_blocked');
  }
}
